title: LearningOS exact-pair release receipt
description: Operational evidence produced by the release-pair GitHub Actions workflow, proving one immutable Core SHA and one immutable UI SHA were checked out clean, built, and passed the paired release gate together. This is not a canonical LearningOS entity: it does not alter the data-contract version, and it lives only under the workbench evidence directory and the workflow's own artifact upload.

manifest_contract_closure_sha256.description: The manifest contract closure digest from Core's declared contract identity. Carried by receipts generated after the closure was added to the release identity; historical receipts without it remain valid and are verified only against the identity they contain.

shipped_asset_sha256.description: Closed hash inventory for every byte shipped in plugin/.

stress_scope.description: The workflow checkout provisions neither repository's external materials tree, so `make stress` cannot run in CI; the mandatory stress gate stays local. A receipt states this explicitly rather than implying stress ran.

live_install_scope.description: What installer and live-environment verification ran for the pair receipt: hosted CI exercises only deterministic fixture tests and `--vault fixture-vault --dry-run` (`ci-fixtures-only`) because the host Obsidian vault is absent; `full` denotes live-vault installer verification.

seatbelt_scope.description: Whether the macOS Seatbelt sandbox suite (`tests/test_study_launch.py`) executed on Darwin without skips (`full`) or was not run (`not-run`). Hosted release gates run a dedicated `macos-15` job and require `full`.
